goal: Ensure the Studio project queue produces at least one active MIM/TOD execution assignment instead of remaining passive backlog.
trigger: Dave observed that MIM/TOD had not accomplished much with projects after the reconciliation layer was added.
audit_basis: Live project event audit showed zero MIM/TOD execution events; visible movement was reconciled prior evidence, Codex audit, or seeded backlog.
implemented_v1: Studio distinguishes reconciled-only evidence from MIM/TOD-originated movement.
Studio displays MIM/TOD, Codex, and Reconciled event counts per project.
A bounded dispatcher assigns one eligible non-Dave-blocked project to MIM/TOD when no dispatch exists.
The dispatch creates a mim_tod_dispatch project event with TOD required and Codex not initially required.
truth_rule: Dispatch is movement, not completion. It proves MIM selected and assigned work; TOD must still produce implementation or validation evidence before progress can advance further.
next_required_layer: TOD execution result binding: when TOD accepts, rejects, completes, stalls, or escalates the dispatched item, it must write a project event and update blocker/next action.
